original_prompt: Edit this outfit product image. Remove the entire pair of black gloves at the bottom left, including their bows/cuffs. Those gloves are unwanted extras. Keep exactly the ivory black camellia bodice and black tulle skirt, one black net-veil hat, one pearl necklace, one pair of gold earrings, and one black quilted flower handbag. Preserve all these remaining objects and their details. No shoes, gloves, person, body parts, mannequin, text or other objects. Pure white background.
